description: Get detailed information about a specific monitor by its ID.

monitor_id.description: The unique identifier of the monitor. Required.

name: get_monitor

outputSchema.description: One monitor in full. On a missing id the tool returns a not-found shape instead of throwing.

error.description: Present and set to 'not_found' when the monitor id does not exist.

monitor.description: The monitor. Absent when not found.

decision_context.description: Stored loan context used when evaluating triggers.

last_triggered_at.description: ISO-8601 last trigger, null if never.

summary.description: Monitor name and status, or a not-found message.
